ctx.x: No, no, we ended up back in Dallas, [Hotel] and they would practice across from Adolphus, and we kept late hours and across we used to hear, when traffic wasn't so enormous, hear bands across the street at Adolphus -- the CasaLoma --
And bands like Pee Wee Hunt, the great white bands. They all would invariably come over and listen to our band and our show.
